exposure: Acute histological chorioamnionitis with fetal inflammatory response
Acute histological chorioamnionitis without fetal inflammatory response
cohort: The study included 107 neonates with Necrotizing Enterocolitis (Bell stage > IIa) with a mean gestational age of 28.1 weeks and birth weight of 1103 g.
finding: Acute histological chorioamnionitis without fetal inflammatory response was associated with higher odds of white matter injury in infants with NEC, but had no significant impact on mortality and other postoperative outcomes.
